401-3944-6634-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-6634-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

1417-4279-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1939-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:

Your life total is 2 or higher.
1939-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

339-677-6495-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-5508.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-5508.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirit token(s) enter, Railway Brawler triggers that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
When the Carnivore token enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on the Carnivore token.
Repeat.

1495-4613-6843-7741.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Shang-Chi.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1518-4499-7494.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
1518-4499-7494.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw two cards and causing instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less to cast until your next turn.
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1792-4404-5060.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-5060.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
457-1792-4404-5060.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Cemetery Prowler.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1824-2530-5061-6556.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-5061-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1824-2530-5061-6556.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1114-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1114-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Wrenn and Realmbreaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2366-3480-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-3480-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

3239-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

3609-3756-6099-6881.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks. When it enters, it and Mossborn Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mossborn Hydra trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
3609-3756-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

2957-3000-4508-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2577-5670-6720.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6720.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1563-2457-6633-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

765-1339-1479-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
765-1339-1479-6674.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Rydia trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1055-6497-6590.description:
Cast Overture by paying its mana cost, causing the opponent named by Sewer Nemesis to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Sewer Nemesis by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in their graveyard, milling the remainder of their library.
1055-6497-6590.notes: If the opponent had an empty graveyard and an odd number of cards in their library when the combo is performed, they will have one card remaining in their library.

2557-4444-5742-5743.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

645-1267-5231-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5231-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

1432-1719-4639.notablePrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
1432-1719-4639.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Ioreth of the Healing House triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-2897.notablePrerequisites:
Gigantoplasm is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-2897.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-2897.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

413-4231-4321-5270-5682.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability, Blasting Station and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Astrid, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1017-1656-3408-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
1017-1656-3408-4762.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Talas Researcher's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

215-3771-4050-4749.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least six +1/+1 counters on it.
215-3771-4050-4749.description:
Cast Somberwald Beastmaster by paying {G}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, 3/3 Beast and 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Wolf and two Beasts, adding {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Somberwald Beastmaster from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1750-2430-3452-3584-4276.notablePrerequisites:
Two additional instant cards in graveyard.
Spellweaver Volute attached to Turnabout.
You control lands that can tap to add at least {6}{U}{U}.
1750-2430-3452-3584-4276.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {4}{U}.
Thousand-Year Storm and Spellweaver Volute trigger.
Resolve Spellweaver Volute's trigger, casting a copy of Turnabout, exiling Turnabout, and attaching Spellweaver Volute to Pull from Eternity.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Turnabout for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn.
Activate your lands by tapping them to add mana.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat the previous two steps for each remaining Turnabout on the stack, resulting in at least {U}{U}{U} plus twelve generic mana available.
Resolve the remaining Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Petals of Insight for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all non-card copies of Petals of Insight, drawing three cards for each one.
Resolve the original Petals of Insight, returning it to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {4}{U}.
Thousand-Year Storm and Spellweaver Volute trigger.
Resolve Spellweaver Volute's trigger, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity, exiling Pull from Eternity, and attaching Spellweaver Volute to any instant card in your graveyard.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Pull from Eternity for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all copies of Pull from Eternity, returning Pull from Eternity, Turnabout, and (if possible) any other instant card from exile to your graveyard.
Resolve the remaining Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Petals of Insight for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all non-card copies of Petals of Insight, drawing three cards for each one.
Resolve the original Petals of Insight, returning it to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {4}{U}.
Thousand-Year Storm and Spellweaver Volute trigger.
Resolve Spellweaver Volute's trigger, casting a copy of the instant it is attached to, exiling that instant card, and attaching Spellweaver Volute to Turnabout.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying the instant for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all copies of the instant.
Resolve the remaining Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Petals of Insight for each other instant or sorcery you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all non-card copies of Petals of Insight, drawing three cards for each one.
Resolve the original Petals of Insight, returning it to your hand.
Repeat, choosing not to draw cards with Petals of Insight when needed to avoid losing the game.

1817-2743-5257.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, targeting the Biovisionary spell.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Double Major, targeting the Biovisionary spell.
Resolve both Double Majors, copying the Biovisionary spell twice.
Resolve all Biovisionary spells.
The nontoken Biovisionary enters the battlefield, triggering Riku's second ability, causing you to pay {G}{U} to create a token copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

876-1475-4050.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Lightning Greaves attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
876-1475-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightning Greaves attached, adding one mana of any color.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

3430-4289-4449.notablePrerequisites: Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
3430-4289-4449.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {2}{R} and untapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.
